title: Sector-resource circularity guard
theorem: If H>=0 and H^{-1}(0)=V, then on visible inputs C(V,V) subset V iff H(C(x,y)) <= H(x)+H(y) for all x,y in V.

observation_separation.finite_dimensional_consequence: a finite separating subfamily yields H(m)=sum ||O_j m||^2, faithful on M

open_target: Derive an independent PDT-native dynamical law that constrains sector generation without merely restating invariance of V.
